description: Issue #35 part 4V, lesson 04-22 (docs/part04v/04-22-characters-indicators-subroutines.md). Uploads three fixed-form RPG IV ports of RPG III programs (V0422A=R0403A, V0422B=R0404A, V0422C=R0405A; src/qrpglesrc/v0422*s.rpgle), the exercise answers V0422D-G (solutions/04-22) and the CASxx/CABxx reading sample V0422P into QRPGLESRC (RCDLEN 112, created if absent), sets SRCTYPE(RPGLE), compiles all with CRTBNDRPG OPTION(*EVENTF) and copies the compile event file into VFYEVF (member name = source member). Four NEGATIVE members record the real compile errors of RPG III habits: V0422W (EXCPT spelling), V0422X (COMP result indicators in the RPG III place, cols 54-59), V0422Y (CLEAR target in Factor 2), V0422Z (the RPG III source src/qrpgsrc/r0404s.rpg pasted unchanged). Their compile listings (spooled file named after the program) are copied into V22LSW..V22LSZ because it is not proven that the event file arrives in QTEMP (part05-lgcvt never connected); EVFEVENT is therefore also tried in &LIB. Every compile is monitored, so a failure does not stop the wrapper. Then CALLs V0422A-G and V0422P (QSYSPRT only, no input files, no interactive I/O, no loop) and copies each QSYSPRT spool into V22SPx (RCDLEN 133, CTLCHAR(*NONE)); DLTSPLF after each capture stops a failed CALL from re-copying the previous spool. Expected V2 values already recorded for the RPG III originals (04-03/04-04/04-05): V0422A 'A=JOHNSON     B=ALHNSON     C=123456  D=1234AB  E=BOB'; V0422B 'REORDER' at cols 31-40; V0422C 'A             SUM= 00015'. Hand-computed, not yet run: V0422D 'A=JOHNSON     B=AL          C=123456  D=    AB  E=BOB'; V0422E the same without E=; V0422F 30 blanks + 'OVER      ' + '  F=OK  S=OFF'; V0422G 'X             SUM= 00015'; V0422P 'BIG        00015'. Unverified: control-spec keyword 'H DFTACTGRP(*YES)'; MOVEL(P)/MOVE(P); packed D-spec fields printing as 00015 without an edit code; DLTSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) JOB(*) SPLNBR(*LAST); CPYSPLF of a compile listing into RCDLEN(133). No RMVLIBLE step on purpose: the harness has no placeholder for the user's first library, and every object here is library-qualified (&LIB/...), so a same-named object in that library cannot be picked up. sshTimeoutMs is raised to 600000 because one connection holds 12 compiles and 8 calls.
